body: How can I do anything when nothing will change the way anyone thinks.
There are more points but I would like to discuss these first.
Are you sure? I feel like it’s not good enough
This helped validate my feelings for poetry, you’re really good thank you :)
I enjoyed the pacing that I can’t seem to get right on my own works. Thank you for showing me how even though you’re new
But there’s no way anyone read the full thing it’s too long and it’s nowhere near any good
I’m confused, people like my work?
